page: Amazon Web Services m8ine.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an Intel x86_64 processor clocked at 3.9 GHz, providing 32 vCPUs across 16 dedicated physical cores with two threads per core. The instance is allocated 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware network capability on the m8ine.8xlarge delivers a baseline network throughput of 50 Gbps. The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage or discrete GPU accelerators, meaning all persistent data and block storage requirements rely entirely on attached network-based storage volumes such as Amazon EBS.

From an infrastructure and resource management perspective, the instance provides high-speed networking capabilities paired with standard general-purpose compute ratios. The dedicated physical core allocation and high base clock frequency suit applications requiring predictable execution times, though total throughput depends on external storage configuration. Workloads suited for this server configuration include enterprise web serving, mid-sized relational database hosting, containerized service clusters, data caching tiers, and continuous integration workflows.
